text:
eve_platform: heads up — tenant `acme-inc` just hit primary model saturation in us-east-1. thinking we should try a sampling-based soft-demotion to a compatible q8 variant to keep tail latency stable. thoughts? :eyes:

ben_dev: +1 on sampling. full redirect will break quality for some customers. what sampling rate do you have in mind?

eve_platform: start with 20% of requests once node saturation > 85%, escalate to 50% if > 95%. keep sticky per-request-id for 5m so we don't flip within a conversation.

carla_sre: we need metrics first — can we surface `variant_demote_rate`, `demote_latency_p50/p95`, and `demote_quality_regressions` in the console? otherwise ops will be blind.

alice_research: quality regressions is the hard one. we should attach a small prompt-set eval for demoted traffic and compute delta in embedding-similarity + BLEU-ish score. run that asynchronously and surface a rolling alert if drift > threshold.

dmitri_infra: implementation note: router already exposes `saturation_ratio` and `tenant_slot_usage`. we can add a sampling hook that checks `(saturation_ratio>=0.85) && (rand()<sampling_rate) && !header:X-Prefer-NoSwap`. header should allow tenant to opt-out.

ben_dev: agree on opt-out header. also add per-tenant console toggle `enable_variant_demote` (default on for free tier, off for enterprise unless they opt in). UI should show recent demotion events and examples of affected requests.

carla_sre: billing question — if a request is demoted to smaller model, do we charge primary or demoted rate? we need a policy and clear console annotation so customers aren't surprised.

eve_platform: proposal: bill by executed model. but include a tenant-level invoice note when demotion_rate > 5% with example traceids. ops can also set `prefer_no_demote_billing=true` to keep original pricing for key contracts.

alice_research: for rollouts: canary the routing change for 1% of tenants flagged `canary=true` for 24h, run quality eval and latency metrics, then widen. do not enable global auto-escalation without passing quality gate.

infra-bot: deploy queued: feature/variant-sampling-router -> staging. build #3421. (ci checks passed) :white_check_mark:

dmitri_infra: infra plan: add router flag `demote_sampling_map:{low:0.2,high:0.5}`, TTL sticky=300s, telemetry tags `demote=soft|hard`, `demote_reason=saturation|quota`. push metrics to datadog as `redwood.router.demote.count` and `redwood.router.demote.latency`.

ben_dev: one more UX ask — make timeline in console show before/after latency and top prompt examples that were demoted. that will help SEs explain behavior to customers quickly.

eve_platform: ok. short-term action items: (1) dmitri implement sampling hook + header opt-out, (2) infra-bot deploy to staging, (3) alice add eval set and alert rule, (4) carla wire metrics to console panels. sync in 48h and decide canary rollout. :thumbsup:

carla_sre: noted. I'll add dashboard widgets and an alert runbook for >3% demote_rate + p95 increase.

alice_research: prepping eval harness now. will share prompt set link in channel when ready.

ben_dev: thanks — sounds safe. one caveat: watch for correlated degradation where demoted variant saturates quickly. if we see that, fallback to queuing/backpressure instead of more demotion.

eve_platform: good call. add spike-protection: if demoted_variant_saturation > 70% then pause sampling and trigger backpressure route.

infra-bot: staging deploy started: feature/variant-sampling-router -> staging. ETA 7m.
